findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_mailauth, audit_mailauth_lite · Private data: audit_mailauth, audit_mailauth_lite · Public sink: audit_mailauth, audit_mailauth_lite.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_mailauth, audit_mailauth_lite · Private data: audit_mailauth, audit_mailauth_lite · Public sink: audit_mailauth, audit_mailauth_lite

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
